Jamali Maddix is 's guest this week. And Jamli’s subgenre is… Fight The System!
Our lone hero must take on the biggest, most oppressive, far-reaching organization yet: Big Hummus. Get ready for a surprisingly relevant, so-crazy-it-could-be-true pitch where team Hummus goes up against Team Steak in a fight to the death. Starring multiple actors who have been dead for years. Enjoy!
